description: Floodlight activity tags, whose parameters ride on the path as semicolon-delimited pairs.

params.name: src
params.description: It is the numeric Floodlight configuration ID for the advertiser.
params.fix_hint: Set `src` to the advertiser's Floodlight configuration ID.

params.name: type
params.description: It is the activity group tag string.
params.fix_hint: Copy `type` from the Floodlight activity in Campaign Manager.

params.name: cat
params.description: It is the activity tag string.
params.fix_hint: Copy `cat` from the Floodlight activity in Campaign Manager.

params.name: ord
params.description: It is the cache buster, so every fire is counted separately.
params.fix_hint: Emit a fresh random value for `ord` on every fire, or `ord=1` with `num` for unique counting.

params.name: num
params.description: Unique counting sends `ord=1` alongside a random `num`.

params.name: qty
params.description: It is the quantity of items on a sales tag. Campaign Manager documents qty as an integer greater than zero. Counter tags omit it.
params.fix_hint: Set `qty` to the item count as a whole number of 1 or more, or drop the pair on a counter tag.

params.name: cost
params.description: It is the revenue amount on a sales tag. Campaign Manager documents cost as a number with no commas or currency symbols. Counter tags omit it.
params.fix_hint: Set `cost` to the order value as a number, such as 19.99, or drop the pair on a counter tag.

params.name: dc_lat
params.description: It is the limited-ads signal. Campaign Manager documents `dc_lat=1` when the user has limited ad tracking enabled.
params.fix_hint: Send `dc_lat=1` when limited ad tracking applies, otherwise `0` or omit it.

params.name: npa
params.description: It is the restricted-processing signal. Campaign Manager documents `npa=1` when the user opts out of remarketing. Exported tags leave it empty until a CMP fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send `npa=1` when the user opts out of remarketing, otherwise `0` or omit it.

params.name: tfua
params.description: It is the under-age signal. Campaign Manager documents `tfua=1` when the request may come from a user under 16. Exported tags leave it empty until a CMP fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send `tfua=1` when the request may come from a user under 16, otherwise `0` or omit it.

params.name: dc_rdid
params.description: It is the resettable device ID. Campaign Manager documents dc_rdid as the unhashed IDFA or Android advertising ID on in-app Floodlight tags. Generated tags leave the slot empty until the app fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send the unhashed IDFA or AdID over HTTPS, or leave the generated empty slot on a web tag.

params.name: tag_for_child_directed_treatment
params.description: It is the COPPA signal. Campaign Manager documents tag_for_child_directed_treatment=1 when the request may come from a user under 13. Generated tags leave the slot empty until the publisher fills it.
params.fix_hint: Send tag_for_child_directed_treatment=1 for COPPA traffic, 0 otherwise, or leave the generated empty slot.

params.name: u1
params.description: It is a Floodlight custom variable. Campaign Manager documents u1-u100 on the activity tag.
params.fix_hint: Fill the custom variable, or drop the empty pair from the tag.

rules.message: The tag counts unique users with `num` but omits `ord`. Unique counting sends `ord=1` together with a random `num`.
rules.fix_hint: Add `ord=1` next to the random `num` value.

rules.message: The tag sends `qty` without `cost`. Campaign Manager documents both on sales conversion tags.
rules.fix_hint: Add `cost` as the revenue amount, with no currency symbol, or drop `qty` on a counter tag.

rules.message: The tag sends `cost` without `qty`. Campaign Manager documents both on sales conversion tags.
rules.fix_hint: Add `qty` as an integer of 1 or more, or drop `cost` on a counter tag.
